note: Same 120-frame robustness subset for F1/recall-under-perturbation; full 612-frame held-out test for mAP50/P/R. These are DIFFERENT metrics (fixed-threshold F1 vs area-under-PR-curve mAP) over DIFFERENT frame sets, not directly comparable to each other numerically -- only within the same table.
conclusion: A full 95-epoch convergence run (E09) did NOT close the gap to raw training on clean held-out data: mAP50 0.081 (E09) vs 0.116 (E04), recall 0.079 vs 0.164 -- E09's recall is actually LOWER than the undertrained E08 (0.142). This revises the Phase-2/3 hypothesis that E08's clean-accuracy deficit was 'just undertraining' -- it is a real, relatively stable accuracy/robustness tradeoff, not a training-budget artifact. On the robustness side, E09 improves over E08 on baseline, speckle=0.25, blur, and resolution-loss F1, but is WORSE than E08 under heavy ping-dropout and speckle=0.5 -- the robustness gain is real but uneven across degradation modes, not a uniform win either. DECISION: E04 remains PRIMARY (best on the authoritative full-test metrics that every other reported number in this project is measured against). E09 is kept and documented as a validated robustness-oriented ALTERNATIVE for deployments where noise robustness matters more than peak clean accuracy -- not promoted to primary.
